newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 1997 grain harvest nears completion.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 1997 grain harvest nears completion.

text.p: Ukraine's 1997 grain harvest, forecast at 37-38 million tonnes this year, is nearly complete, a government statement said on Tuesday.
"Harvesting is nearing completion. The majority of grain-growing regions have gathered 75 to 90 percent of sown areas," it said.
The statement added that 25 million tonnes of grain had been threshed, compared to 19.95 million tonnes on August 11.
Last year's drought-hit harvest was 25.4 million tonnes.
Average yields this year were 2.68 tonnes per hectare, the statement said.
